subproblem.title: The co-area formula is countably additive over a Borel partition modulo a null set with null slices (Simon Ch. 3, 2.8–2.9)
subproblem.statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, M ⊆ ℝ^P Borel, f : ℝ^P → ℝ Borel, G : ℝ^P → ℝ^P any map, and A_j ⊆ M (j ∈ ℕ) pairwise disjoint Borel sets. Write M₀ := M ∖ ⋃_j A_j and Hᵏ = μHE[k]. Assume H^{n+1}(M₀) = 0; Hⁿ(M₀ ∩ f⁻¹(t)) = 0 for L¹-a.e. t ∈ ℝ; and for every j and every Borel g : ℝ^P → [0, ∞], t ↦ ∫_{A_j∩f⁻¹(t)} g dHⁿ is L¹-a.e.-measurable and ∫_ℝ ∫_{A_j∩f⁻¹(t)} g dHⁿ dt = ∫_{A_j} |G| g dH^{n+1}. Then for every Borel g : ℝ^P → [0, ∞], t ↦ ∫_{M∩f⁻¹(t)} g dHⁿ is L¹-a.e.-measurable and ∫_ℝ ∫_{M∩f⁻¹(t)} g dHⁿ dt = ∫_M |G| g dH^{n+1}. (All integrals are lower Lebesgue integrals in [0, ∞]; |G| enters as ENNReal.ofReal ‖G x‖; dt is Lebesgue measure on ℝ.)
subproblem.lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (G : Euclid P → Euclid P) (A : ℕ → Set (Euclid P)), MeasurableSet M → Measurable f → (∀ j, MeasurableSet (A j)) → (∀ j, A j ⊆ M) → Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (A i) (A j)) → μHE[n + 1] (M \ ⋃ j, A j) = 0 → (∀ᵐ t, μHE[n] ((M \ ⋃ j, A j) ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}) = 0) → (∀ j, ∀ g : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable g → AEMeasurable (fun t => ∫⁻ x in A j ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}, g x ∂μHE[n]) ∧ ∫⁻ t, ∫⁻ x in A j ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}, g x ∂μHE[n] = ∫⁻ x in A j, ENNReal.ofReal ‖G x‖ * g x ∂μHE[n + 1]) → ∀ g : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable g → AEMeasurable (fun t => ∫⁻ x in M ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}, g x ∂μHE[n]) ∧ ∫⁻ t, ∫⁻ x in M ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}, g x ∂μHE[n] = ∫⁻ x in M, ENNReal.ofReal ‖G x‖ * g x ∂μHE[n + 1]
subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: step 4 of the parent proof (Simon Ch. 3, 2.8–2.9: the co-area formula "follows from the C¹ case … by using the decomposition M = ⋃_j M_j"). The null part M₀ is handled by the hypothesis on its slices; in the parent this hypothesis comes from Eilenberg's inequality.
Notation: μ := Hⁿ, ν := H^{n+1}; for t ∈ ℝ, S_t := M ∩ f⁻¹(t) and S_{j,t} := A_j ∩ f⁻¹(t). Fix a Borel g : ℝ^P → [0, ∞] and put h_j(t) := ∫_{S_{j,t}} g dμ, H(t) := ∫_{S_t} g dμ, w(x) := ofReal|G(x)|·g(x).

1. (Slices.) f is Borel, so f⁻¹({t}) and each S_{j,t} are Borel. The S_{j,t} (j ∈ ℕ) are pairwise disjoint because the A_j are.
2. (Pointwise decomposition of H.) Let T₀ := {t : μ(M₀ ∩ f⁻¹(t)) = 0}; by hypothesis a.e. t lies in T₀. Fix t ∈ T₀. As A_j ⊆ M, ⋃_j S_{j,t} ⊆ S_t, and S_t ∖ ⋃_j S_{j,t} = M₀ ∩ f⁻¹(t) is μ-null. Hence S_t =ᵐ[μ] ⋃_j S_{j,t} (ae_eq_set: both differences are null), so μ⌞S_t = μ⌞(⋃_j S_{j,t}) (Measure.restrict_congr_set), and by countable additivity of the integral over pairwise disjoint measurable sets (lintegral_iUnion),
 H(t) = ∫_{⋃_j S_{j,t}} g dμ = Σ_j h_j(t).
 So H = Σ_j h_j L¹-a.e.
3. (a.e.-measurability.) Each h_j is a.e.-measurable (hypothesis), so t ↦ Σ_j h_j(t) is a.e.-measurable (AEMeasurable.tsum), and H, which is a.e. equal to it by step 2, is a.e.-measurable (AEMeasurable.congr).
4. (Left side.) ∫_ℝ H dt = ∫_ℝ Σ_j h_j dt (lintegral_congr_ae and step 2) = Σ_j ∫_ℝ h_j dt (lintegral_tsum, which needs only the a.e.-measurability of each h_j) = Σ_j ∫_{A_j} w dν (the hypothesis for each j).
5. (Right side.) ν(M₀) = 0 and ⋃_j A_j ⊆ M, so M =ᵐ[ν] ⋃_j A_j and ν⌞M = ν⌞(⋃_j A_j). The A_j are measurable and pairwise disjoint, so lintegral_iUnion (valid for every [0, ∞]-valued integrand, measurable or not) gives ∫_M w dν = ∫_{⋃_j A_j} w dν = Σ_j ∫_{A_j} w dν.
6. Steps 4 and 5 give ∫_ℝ H dt = ∫_M w dν, and step 3 gives the a.e.-measurability of H. ∎

```lean
theorem Submission.dtc_bc_lc_sl_co_coarea_glue : ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (G : Euclid P → Euclid P) (A : ℕ → Set (Euclid P)), MeasurableSet M → Measurable f → (∀ j, MeasurableSet (A j)) → (∀ j, A j ⊆ M) → Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (A i) (A j)) → μHE[n + 1] (M \ ⋃ j, A j) = 0 → (∀ᵐ t, μHE[n] ((M \ ⋃ j, A j) ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}) = 0) → (∀ j, ∀ g : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable g → AEMeasurable (fun t => ∫⁻ x in A j ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}, g x ∂μHE[n]) ∧ ∫⁻ t, ∫⁻ x in A j ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}, g x ∂μHE[n] = ∫⁻ x in A j, ENNReal.ofReal ‖G x‖ * g x ∂μHE[n + 1]) → ∀ g : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable g → AEMeasurable (fun t => ∫⁻ x in M ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}, g x ∂μHE[n]) ∧ ∫⁻ t, ∫⁻ x in M ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}, g x ∂μHE[n] = ∫⁻ x in M, ENNReal.ofReal ‖G x‖ * g x ∂μHE[n + 1] := by
  intro P n M f G A hM hf hA hAM hdisj hM0 hslice hAj g hg
  have hfib : ∀ t : ℝ, MeasurableSet (f ⁻¹' {t}) := fun t => hf (measurableSet_singleton t)
  have hSj : ∀ t : ℝ, ∀ j, MeasurableSet (A j ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}) := fun t j => (hA j).inter (hfib t)
  have hdisjt : ∀ t : ℝ, Pairwise (Disjoint on fun j => A j ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}) := fun t i j hij =>
    (hdisj hij).mono inter_subset_left inter_subset_left
  -- Step 2: pointwise decomposition of the slice integral for a.e. `t`
  have hdec : ∀ᵐ t, ∫⁻ x in M ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}, g x ∂μHE[n]
      = ∑' j, ∫⁻ x in A j ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}, g x ∂μHE[n] := by
    filter_upwards [hslice] with t ht
    rw [← lintegral_iUnion (hSj t) (hdisjt t) g]
    apply setLIntegral_congr
    rw [ae_eq_set]
    constructor
    · refine measure_mono_null ?_ ht
      rintro y ⟨⟨hyM, hyf⟩, hy⟩
      refine ⟨⟨hyM, ?_⟩, hyf⟩
      intro hyA
      obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := mem_iUnion.1 hyA
      exact hy (mem_iUnion.2 ⟨j, hj, hyf⟩)
    · have hsub : (⋃ j, A j ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}) \ (M ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}) = ∅ := by
        rw [sdiff_eq_empty]
        exact iUnion_subset fun j => inter_subset_inter_left _ (hAM j)
      rw [hsub, measure_empty]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · -- Step 3: a.e.-measurability
    exact (AEMeasurable.tsum fun j => (hAj j g hg).1).congr
      (hdec.mono fun t ht => ht.symm)
  · -- Steps 4-6
    rw [lintegral_congr_ae hdec, lintegral_tsum fun j => (hAj j g hg).1]
    have hj : ∀ j, ∫⁻ t, ∫⁻ x in A j ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}, g x ∂μHE[n]
        = ∫⁻ x in A j, ENNReal.ofReal ‖G x‖ * g x ∂μHE[n + 1] := fun j => (hAj j g hg).2
    simp_rw [hj]
    rw [← lintegral_iUnion hA hdisj (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal ‖G x‖ * g x)]
    apply setLIntegral_congr
    rw [ae_eq_set]
    constructor
    · have hsub : (⋃ j, A j) \ M = ∅ := by
        rw [sdiff_eq_empty]
        exact iUnion_subset hAM
      rw [hsub, measure_empty]
    · exact hM0
```
proof_key_steps: For a.e. t the slice of the null part M₀ is Hⁿ-null, so M ∩ f⁻¹(t) = ⋃_j A_j ∩ f⁻¹(t) up to an Hⁿ-null set and ∫_{M∩f⁻¹(t)} g = Σ_j ∫_{A_j∩f⁻¹(t)} g.
a.e.-measurability passes to the countable sum and to a.e.-equal functions.
lintegral_tsum and the per-piece co-area identities give ∫_ℝ ∫_{M∩f⁻¹(t)} g dHⁿ dt = Σ_j ∫_{A_j} |G| g dH^{n+1}.
H^{n+1}(M₀) = 0 and countable additivity give Σ_j ∫_{A_j} |G| g dH^{n+1} = ∫_M |G| g dH^{n+1}.
